name: hero-section
purpose: The opening band of a marketing page: the page `h1` with its overline, accent phrase, sentence and up to two actions, full width above the page column, with an optional client strip on the floor. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'hero-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `hero`, `hero-title`, `button` and `illustration`, plus `flow-diagram` and `tag` for the topology and `section-container`, `section-module`, `registration-frame`, `card-grid`, `feature-item` and `section-gap` for the argument grid. `variant` picks the layout only: `center` fills a screen over a dot field with the copy centered, `title-band` is a padded band with the copy centered, `pixel-floor` sets the copy at the start over an animated pixel floor, `copy-beside-art` sets an illustration (or an `image`) beside the copy, sized from that illustration's own drawn bounds so it bleeds past the column edge and trims its empty top and bottom, and `copy-on-top-art` fills a screen with the copy centered over a scene in its `top` or `bottom` slot, unpadded so the scene reaches the band's edges, and draws a `FlowDiagram` topology from `levels` in the bottom window when neither slot is given, so page JSON can carry the scene as data; every layout takes the same copy, actions and client strip, and any layout can set a framed grid of arguments (`items`, three to a row, each a `FeatureItem`) under the band. The client strip's overline falls back to the locale catalog (`Proven on mission-critical workloads`).
useWhen: Use HeroSection for every marketing page opening; pick the layout with `variant`.

To open a home, solution, product, listing or contact page with its headline and main actions; add `items` for a grid of arguments under it, or `levels` with `variant="copy-on-top-art"` for a topology under the copy.
Rendering page JSON, or you need a whole band with no custom content → the section (`hero-section`). Building an SFC by hand, needing slots, or nesting inside another band → the primitive (`hero`).
avoidWhen: When the page exists to capture a lead and the form sits above the fold → use `hero-form-section`.
In a hand-built SFC that needs slots HeroSection does not offer → use the `hero` primitive.
For a band inside the page column → use `section-module` or a sibling section.
related: `hero` — the band primitive every layout is rendered with.
`hero-title` — the headline block rendered inside it.
`hero-form-section` — the opening band with a lead form beside the copy.
`flow-diagram` — the diagram primitive the `levels` topology is drawn with.
`feature-item` — the icon, heading and sentence each argument of `items` is rendered with.
bestPractices: Use `title-band` with `size="large"` for a product page and `size="medium"` for a page whose bands start right under the headline.
Give `illustration` and `illustrationAriaLabel` only to the `copy-beside-art` layout; the other layouts ignore them.

Leave `titleLength` at `short` for a headline of up to about seven words: like azion.com, the `center`, `title-band` and `center-band` layouts set it on a narrower measure than the sentence under it, so "Certifications and Compliance" breaks over two lines. Use `long` only for a headline that would run to three lines.

Leave `headerOffset` at its default under `SiteHeader`: it takes the bar's `--layout-header-height` out of a band that fills a screen, so the band fills exactly the first screen with it. Set it empty only on a page with no header above the band; never a literal length.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Layout of the band: `center` fills a screen over a dot field, `title-band` is a padded band, `center-band` is a large site-wide band with the copy centered, `compact-band` is a short site-wide band with the copy at the start, `pixel-floor` sets the copy over an animated pixel floor, `copy-beside-art` sets an illustration or an image beside the copy, `copy-on-top-art` fills a screen with the copy centered over a scene in the `top` or `bottom` slot.

props.name: size
props.doc: Vertical rhythm of the band; `large` is the opening a product page leads with.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short overline above the headline.

props.name: titleHighlight
props.doc: Opening words of the headline, painted in the brand accent; reads as one sentence with `title`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Page headline, rendered as the page `h1`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: description
props.doc: Sentence under the headline.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the headline; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Shown only with a label and a link.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second, outlined button beside the first; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Shown only with a label and a link.

props.name: marqueeLabel
props.doc: Eyebrow above the client marquee; empty uses the locale catalog (`Proven on mission-critical workloads`).

props.name: marqueeMarks
props.doc: Registry names of the client marks on the band floor, in order; the marquee renders only when it has marks.

props.name: illustration
props.doc: Registry name of the illustration set beside the copy in the `copy-beside-art` layout.

props.name: illustrationAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible description of the illustration.

props.name: image
props.doc: Image set beside the copy in the `copy-beside-art` layout when no `illustration` is given; `{ src, alt, width, height }`. A portrait image (taller than wide) is drawn at half width, centered, below `md`.

props.name: eyebrowPrefix
props.doc: Mark set before the eyebrow (`//`, `<>`, `</>`, or empty for none); drawn only with an eyebrow.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: headerOffset
props.doc: Height of the site header above the band, taken out of a band that fills a screen; defaults to the `SiteHeader` bar's token, any CSS length, empty for a page with no header above it.

props.name: titleLength
props.doc: Length of the headline: `short` sets it on the site's narrow headline measure in the centered layouts, so a four-to-seven-word headline breaks over two balanced lines while the sentence under it keeps the full column; `long` lets the headline take the whole column.

props.name: plain
props.doc: Drops the dot texture of the `center` layout.

props.name: levels
props.doc: Columns of the topology the `copy-on-top-art` layout draws under the copy when neither scene slot is given, left to right; each is `{ nodes }`, the cards top to bottom, each `{ eyebrow, icon, title, label, severity, lit? }`. A card without `title` is skipped.

props.name: items
props.doc: Arguments in a framed grid under the band, three to a row; each is `{ icon, title, description }`. The grid renders only when there are items.

slots.name: top
slots.notes: A scene in the window above the copy (`ConsoleMockup`, a diagram). The design sample's hero scenes render here.

slots.name: bottom
slots.notes: A scene in the window under the copy; it enters after the copy (`animate-content-enter`, off under reduced motion) and fades at the inline edges on narrow containers.
